item_title: Dia de la Virgen de Guadalupe proclamation
document_text: 1.3 Councilmember Peter Ortiz presented a proclamation declaring December 12, 2025, as Dia de la Virgen de Guadalupe, honoring the cultural, spiritual, and historical significance of this day and recognizing its role in fostering faith, unity, and community tradition in the City of San Jose.

people.source_text: Councilmember Peter Ortiz presented a proclamation
